links.outcome: Diagnostic concordance of pathologist reassessment with versus without AI-generated FFPE images in discrepant cases
links.effect: Among 55 discrepant cases, GenFFPE-based reassessment increased diagnostic concordance by 53.3%.
links.quote: Among 55 discrepant cases, GenFFPE-based reassessment increased diagnostic concordance by 53.3%.

unlisted_practices: Translating frozen-section pathology images into FFPE-style images with generative AI to improve intraoperative diagnosis
Visual Turing test with pathologists to assess realism of AI-generated histology images

screen.reason: Evaluates generative AI (image-to-image translation) for pathology frozen-to-FFPE conversion in an offline reader/reassessment study without testing deployment guardrails or implementation practices.
